papers.title: Comparative analysis of protease-inhibitor gene family counts under different counting units and genome annotations
papers.translated_title: 不同计数单位和基因组注释下蛋白酶抑制剂基因家族数量的比较分析
papers.author: Zhao, F.
papers.summary: Background: Gene family sizes are often compared across species using the protein sets released with genome assemblies. However, counts of domain-positive protein entries can differ from counts of genes when an annotation contains several entries per gene, and genomes are annotated by different pipelines. In this study, we measured how these two factors change the counts of protease-inhibitor domain families. Results: Seven protease-inhibitor families were counted in eight animal genomes. Collapsing protein entries to genes reduced the counts in 36 of 48 species-family combinations, by up to 4.6-fold (Kunitz/BPTI in Aedes aegypti, 23 entries in 5 genes), and reversed the order of two species in 9 of 196 pairwise comparisons. In 218 of 223 gene-family records with several positive entries, all entries shared CDS coordinates with the representative entry. Two annotations of the same leech (Hirudinaria manillensis) assembly differed in a family-specific way. In the published annotation, 38 of 50 Antistasin-positive genes and both Hirudin-positive genes had no same-strand gene model in a second annotation, whereas most Kunitz/BPTI, Serpin, TIL and Thyroglobulin genes had one-to-one partners. A search of the eight assemblies without gene models detected all 338 annotated Kunitz/BPTI-positive genes when the queries included proteins of the same species. Queries from other species recovered only 31-83% of these genes, and Kunitz-like candidate regions outside the annotations were most numerous in the tick Ixodes scapularis. For the mosquito and the tick, the second public annotations shared nearly all gene-model coordinates with RefSeq and were therefore excluded from the comparison of annotation sources. Conclusions: These results indicate that gene family counts depend on the counting unit and on the annotation source. Comparisons across species should count each gene once and state how domain positivity was assigned to genes. In addition, the source and version of each annotation should be reported, the annotations should be checked against the genome assembly, and the overlap of gene models should be examined before two annotations are compared.
papers.translated_summary: 背景：基因家族大小常通过基因组组装发布的蛋白质集在不同物种间进行比较。然而，当注释中每个基因有多个条目时，结构域阳性蛋白质条目的计数可能与基因计数不同，而且基因组由不同的流程注释。在本研究中，我们测量了这两个因素如何改变蛋白酶抑制剂结构域家族的计数。结果：在八个动物基因组中计数了七个蛋白酶抑制剂家族。将蛋白质条目合并为基因后，48个物种-家族组合中有36个的计数减少，最多减少4.6倍（埃及伊蚊中的Kunitz/BPTI，5个基因中有23个条目），并在196个成对比较中的9个中逆转了两个物种的顺序。在223个具有多个阳性条目的基因家族记录中，有218个的所有条目与代表条目共享CDS坐标。同一水蛭（Hirudinaria manillensis）组装的两个注释以家族特异性方式不同。在已发表的注释中，50个Antistasin阳性基因中的38个和两个Hirudin阳性基因在第二个注释中没有同链基因模型，而大多数Kunitz/BPTI、Serpin、TIL和Thyroglobulin基因具有一对一配对。在没有基因模型的八个组装中搜索，当查询包括同一物种的蛋白质时，检测到所有338个注释的Kunitz/BPTI阳性基因。来自其他物种的查询仅恢复了这些基因的31-83%，而注释外的Kunitz样候选区域在肩突硬蜱中最为众多。对于蚊子和蜱，第二个公共注释与RefSeq共享几乎所有基因模型坐标，因此被排除在注释来源的比较之外。结论：这些结果表明基因家族计数取决于计数单位和注释来源。跨物种比较应每个基因计数一次，并说明结构域阳性如何分配给基因。此外，应报告每个注释的来源和版本，应将注释与基因组组装进行核对，并在比较两个注释之前检查基因模型的重叠。

papers.title: VoroTIDE: Protein domain segmentation through independent hierarchical searches using Voronoi tessellation and physical self-containment
papers.translated_title: VoroTIDE：通过使用Voronoi镶嵌和物理自包含性的独立层次搜索进行蛋白质结构域分割
papers.author: Le, K. Q.
papers.summary: Protein domains are commonly regarded as structurally separated, functionally relevant, and evolutionarily separable units. Although classification systems may assign different domain boundaries to the same structure, structural separation remains a shared criterion, and many domain parsers assess it through inter-residue distances, contact numbers, or contact densities. However, the Voronoi contact area, which is widely used to study protein-protein interactions and predict contact sites, has seen limited use in domain parsing. There are two potential challenges to this problem. First, unlike in protein-protein interaction, partitions are not known in advance and must be identified before their interface can be evaluated. Second, the contact area depends on fragment size and internal packing, making it difficult to compare candidate partitions. Here, we introduce VoroTIDE (Voronoi-based Two-way Independent Domain Exploration), a domain parser based on all-heavy-atom Voronoi contact areas. By normalizing the contact area for fragment size and internal packing, and incorporating residue hydropathy, we define a pairwise self-containment score F. VoroTIDE applies F in two independent hierarchical searches: top-down recursive splitting until no admissible division remains, and bottom-up merging of secondary-structure elements until the entire structure becomes a single fragment. Intermediate partitions from both searches are ranked by a global partition quality score G, derived on the same principle. On two CATH-ECOD consensus benchmarks, under balanced evaluation, VoroTIDE achieved the strongest performance among all tested criterion-based parsers and was comparable to Chainsaw, the best-performing deep learning method tested. These results show that the Voronoi-based criterion can yield competitive domain parsing.
papers.translated_summary: 蛋白质结构域通常被视为结构上分离、功能相关且进化上可分离的单元。尽管分类系统可能对同一结构赋予不同的结构域边界，但结构分离性仍是一个共同标准，许多结构域解析器通过残基间距离、接触数或接触密度来评估这一标准。然而，广泛用于研究蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用和预测接触位点的Voronoi接触面积，在结构域解析中的应用却较为有限。该问题存在两个潜在挑战。首先，与蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用不同，分区并非预先已知，必须在评估其界面之前加以识别。其次，接触面积取决于片段大小和内部堆积，使得候选分区之间难以比较。在此，我们引入VoroTIDE（基于Voronoi的双向独立结构域探索），一种基于全重原子Voronoi接触面积的结构域解析器。通过对接触面积按片段大小和内部堆积进行归一化，并结合残基疏水性，我们定义了成对自包含评分F。VoroTIDE在两种独立的层次搜索中应用F：自顶向下递归分裂直至不存在可允许的划分，以及自底向上合并二级结构元件直至整个结构成为单一片段。两种搜索产生的中间分区按基于相同原理推导的全局分区质量评分G进行排序。在两个CATH-ECOD共识基准上，在平衡评估下，VoroTIDE在所有测试的基于准则的解析器中取得了最强性能，并与测试中表现最佳的深度学习方法Chainsaw相当。这些结果表明，基于Voronoi的准则能够产生具有竞争力的结构域解析结果。

papers.title: Integrative structure determination of a human mitochondrial contact site and cristae organizing system (MICOS) sub-assembly
papers.translated_title: 人类线粒体接触位点和嵴组织系统（MICOS）亚复合体的整合结构测定
papers.author: Jindal, M.
papers.summary: The Mitochondrial contact site and Cristae Organizing System (MICOS) complex is an inner mitochondrial membrane (IMM) assembly present at the cristae junction. It is responsible for regulating cristae formation and remodeling. However, its structure is not known. We applied Bayesian integrative structure determination to characterize the structure of the Mic60, Mic19, Mic10, and Mic13-containing MICOS sub-assembly combining AlphaFold predictions with data from crosslinking mass spectrometry, biochemical assays, electron tomography, homology modeling, and sequence alignments. The integrative structure revealed novel mutual interfaces among Mic10N,C, Mic60LBS1,LBS2,mitofilin, and Mic13central,C. Several likely-pathogenic missense mutations also localize to these novel interfaces, highlighting their importance. Further, we investigated some of these interactions using binding assays on purified proteins and demonstrated direct interactions among Mic10-Mic13-Mic60. Our results support a bridging role for Mic13 in the MICOS assembly, by binding Mic10 in the IMM-proximal region and Mic60 in the intermembrane space. Taken together, our integrative approach sheds light on the structure and assembly of the MICOS complex.
papers.translated_summary: 线粒体接触位点与嵴组织系统（MICOS）复合体是位于嵴连接处的线粒体内膜（IMM）组装体。它负责调控嵴的形成与重塑。然而，其结构尚不清楚。我们应用贝叶斯整合结构测定方法，结合AlphaFold预测与交联质谱、生化实验、电子断层扫描、同源建模和序列比对数据，表征了包含Mic60、Mic19、Mic10和Mic13的MICOS亚组装体结构。该整合结构揭示了Mic10N,C、Mic60LBS1,LBS2,mitofilin和Mic13central,C之间新的相互界面。若干可能致病的错义突变也定位于这些新界面，凸显了其重要性。此外，我们通过纯化蛋白的结合实验研究了一些相互作用，并证明了Mic10-Mic13-Mic60之间的直接相互作用。我们的结果支持Mic13在MICOS组装中的桥接作用，即通过结合IMM近端区域的Mic10和膜间隙的Mic60。综上所述，我们的整合方法揭示了MICOS复合体的结构与组装。

papers.title: Continuous, high-speed 3D topographic profiling of living tissue monolayers
papers.translated_title: 活体组织单层的连续高速三维形貌测量
papers.author: Shin, D.
papers.summary: Tissue monolayers are active living matter whose three-dimensional (3D) architecture and mechanical remodeling regulate tissue function, yet fast and continuous topographic monitoring remains difficult. Here, we present FLuorescence EXclusion microscopy fOr Monolayers (FLEXOM), a microfluidic platform that combines multilayer micropillar arrays with negative-staining optics to convert wide-field images into self-calibrated 3D height maps. Geometry-anchored reference cavities maintain in-frame calibration standards even in fully confluent monolayer fields, enabling continuous 3D profiling from isolated cells to confluent sheets with sub-second temporal resolution (~250 ms), sub-micrometer axial precision (~0.37 m), and multi-day biocompatibility and operational stability (>96 h). FLEXOM reveals two distinct anisotropic signatures in tissue monolayers. First, monolayers of different cell types show distinct vertical thickness profiles despite comparable lateral footprints. Only two vertical descriptors, mean height and height variability, distinguished cell types more accurately than nine 2D lateral descriptors, including area, circularity, and convexity (95% vs. 76%). Second, under acute osmotic shock, confluent monolayers exhibit geometrically anisotropic and temporally decoupled vertical-lateral remodeling: height changes dominate the overall volume response and precede lateral remodeling. Surprisingly, cyclic isotonic-hypotonic pulses every 3 min confine remodeling entirely to the vertical axis. Overall, our work provides a high-resolution 3D profiling tool and a framework for axis-resolved analysis of topographic responses in active living matter.
papers.translated_summary: 组织单层是活跃的生命物质，其三维（3D）结构和力学重塑调控组织功能，但快速连续的地形监测仍然困难。在此，我们提出用于单层的荧光排除显微镜（FLEXOM），一种微流控平台，将多层微柱阵列与负染色光学相结合，将宽场图像转换为自校准的3D高度图。几何锚定的参考腔即使在完全汇合的单层视野中也能保持帧内校准标准，从而能够以亚秒级时间分辨率（约250 ms）、亚微米级轴向精度（约0.37 m）以及多天生物相容性和操作稳定性（>96 h）对从孤立细胞到汇合片层的连续3D剖面进行成像。FLEXOM揭示了组织单层中两种不同的各向异性特征。首先，不同细胞类型的单层尽管横向足迹相当，但显示出不同的垂直厚度剖面。仅两个垂直描述符，即平均高度和高度变异性，就比九个2D横向描述符（包括面积、圆度和凸度）更准确地区分细胞类型（95% vs. 76%）。其次，在急性渗透休克下，汇合单层表现出几何各向异性和时间解耦的垂直-横向重塑：高度变化主导整体体积响应，并先于横向重塑。令人惊讶的是，每3分钟的循环等渗-低渗脉冲将重塑完全限制在垂直轴上。总体而言，我们的工作提供了一种高分辨率3D剖面分析工具，以及一个用于活跃生命物质中地形响应的轴分辨分析的框架。

papers.title: Somatostatin-excitatory coordination emerges with dexterous motor skill learning
papers.translated_title: 生长抑素-兴奋性协调随着灵巧运动技能学习而出现
papers.author: Wheeler Fox, G.
papers.summary: Motor skill-learning increases spatio-temporal consistency in neuronal activity in primary motor cortex (M1), and Somatostatin-expressing (SST) interneurons are causally involved in these learning-related activity changes. Yet, how SST-excitatory interactions shape population level activity changes during motor skill acquisition is still unknown. Here, we imaged large populations of excitatory neurons and identified SST or parvalbumin-expressing (PV) interneurons across successive days as mice learned a dexterous, persistently M1-dependent reach-to-grasp task. Sparse, temporally coordinated, trial-resolved, and rate-controlled functional interactions between SST neurons and skill-modulated excitatory neurons emerged with learning and were stronger than those in excitatory-excitatory or PV-excitatory pairs. Interactions strengthened as neurons were recruited to the skill-modulated ensemble and weakened when skill modulation was lost. SST activity also became temporally reliable earlier than excitatory or PV activity, and SST consistency was significantly associated with behavioral performance even after controlling for training session number. Additionally, SST neurons carried more information about movement kinematics than randomly selected subsets of excitatory neurons. Overall, SST neurons became selectively coordinated with behaviorally relevant excitatory populations, revealing a cell-type-specific functional architecture for dexterous motor learning.
papers.translated_summary: 运动技能学习会增加初级运动皮层（M1）神经元活动的时空一致性，而表达生长抑素（SST）的中间神经元与这些学习相关的活动变化存在因果关联。然而，SST-兴奋性相互作用如何在运动技能习得过程中塑造群体水平的活动变化仍不清楚。在本研究中，我们在小鼠连续多天学习一项灵巧的、持续依赖M1的伸抓任务过程中，对大规模兴奋性神经元群体进行成像，并识别SST或表达小清蛋白（PV）的中间神经元。随着学习进程，SST神经元与技能调制兴奋性神经元之间出现了稀疏的、时间协调的、试次分辨的、速率控制的功能性相互作用，且这些相互作用强于兴奋性-兴奋性或PV-兴奋性配对。当神经元被招募到技能调制集合中时，相互作用增强；当技能调制丧失时，相互作用减弱。SST活动在时间可靠性上也早于兴奋性或PV活动，且即使在控制训练 session 数量的情况下，SST一致性与行为表现仍显著相关。此外，与随机选取的兴奋性神经元子集相比，SST神经元携带更多关于运动运动学的信息。总体而言，SST神经元与行为相关的兴奋性群体形成了选择性协调，揭示了灵巧运动学习的一种细胞类型特异性的功能架构。

papers.title: Differential endothelial cell remodeling in Down syndrome and APP duplication drives distinct blood brain barrier dysfunction
papers.translated_title: 唐氏综合征与APP重复中内皮细胞重塑的差异驱动不同的血脑屏障功能障碍
papers.author: Valay, L.
papers.summary: An extra copy of the amyloid precursor protein gene (APP) is present in Down syndrome (DS) and APP duplication (APPdup), increasing the risk of Alzheimer disease (AD) and cerebral amyloid angiopathy (CAA). However, we reported greater vascular A{beta} deposition in APPdup than in DS with AD, suggesting that other triplicated chromosome 21 genes may mitigate CAA severity. We investigated endothelial cell (EC) function and blood brain barrier (BBB) integrity in DS and APPdup using human induced pluripotent stem cell-derived ECs (iECs), assessing their morphology, junctional proteins, A{beta} peptide secretion, barrier function, and transcriptomic profiles. Both DS and APPdup iECs secreted more A{beta}40 A{beta}42 compared with their respective isogenic controls but exhibited distinct A{beta} peptide profiles. DS iECs showed increased junctional protein expression and reduced permeability, whereas APPdup iECs displayed increased permeability. Transcriptomic analysis revealed extensive dysregulation in DS iECs, with enrichment of junctional, adhesion, angiogenic, immune, and apoptosis pathways, and reduced cell-cycle, proliferative, and membrane-targeting signatures. APPdup iECs showed milder changes, including impaired protein targeting and reduced adhesion-related pathways. Despite comparable APP dosage, DS iECs maintained greater junctional integrity and lower permeability than APPdup iECs, potentially contributing to differential CAA vulnerability. However, impaired proliferation and altered angiogenesis may reduce BBB resilience during ageing.
papers.translated_summary: 唐氏综合征（DS）和淀粉样前体蛋白基因重复（APPdup）中均存在淀粉样前体蛋白基因（APP）的额外拷贝，增加阿尔茨海默病（AD）和脑淀粉样血管病（CAA）的风险。然而，我们曾报道APPdup中血管Aβ沉积多于伴AD的DS，提示其他三体21号染色体基因可能减轻CAA的严重程度。我们利用人诱导多能干细胞来源的内皮细胞（iECs）研究了DS和APPdup中的内皮细胞（EC）功能和血脑屏障（BBB）完整性，评估了其形态、连接蛋白、Aβ肽分泌、屏障功能和转录组谱。DS和APPdup的iECs与其各自的同基因对照相比均分泌更多的Aβ40和Aβ42，但表现出不同的Aβ肽谱。DS的iECs显示连接蛋白表达增加和通透性降低，而APPdup的iECs则显示通透性增加。转录组分析揭示DS的iECs存在广泛失调，连接、黏附、血管生成、免疫和凋亡通路富集，而细胞周期、增殖和膜靶向特征减少。APPdup的iECs变化较轻微，包括蛋白质靶向受损和黏附相关通路减少。尽管APP剂量相当，DS的iECs比APPdup的iECs维持更高的连接完整性和更低的通透性，可能导致了CAA易感性的差异。然而，增殖受损和血管生成改变可能在衰老过程中降低BBB的恢复能力。

papers.title: Algorithmic Geometry Shapes the Biological Meaning of Thalamocortical Structural Covariance
papers.translated_title: 算法几何塑造丘脑皮质结构协方差的生物学意义
papers.author: Liu, Y.
papers.summary: Neuroimaging studies often derive and discuss structural covariance (SC) as a representation of underlying brain circuitry that reflects coordinated maturation, anatomical connectivity, transcriptional similarity, and shared genetic influences. These associations motivate its use to study brain organization across development, aging, and disease. However, the algorithms used to derive SC networks impose constraints that may shape their biological interpretation. To understand the impact of algorithm choice, we used the thalamocortical system as an example and compared five common representations of voxelwise SC, namely, principal component analysis (PCA), independent component analysis (ICA), non-negative matrix factorization (NMF), orthogonal projective NMF (OPNMF), and \textit{k}-means clustering, in 755 participants aged 8--22 years from the Philadelphia Neurodevelopmental Cohort (PNC). SC networks derived from deformation-based morphometry (DBM) were evaluated against three complementary biological benchmarks: age-related individual differences, fractional-anisotropy (FA)-based microstructural connectivity of regionally-specific thalamocortical connections, and Allen Human Brain Atlas gene expression. Each algorithm demonstrated underlying sensitivity to differing aspects of neurobiology: PCA and OPNMF showed the strongest associations between participant-level component weights and age. NMF, OPNMF, and \textit{k}-means showed greater spatial overlap between positive cortical SC and tractography-derived projections. ICA and PCA showed stronger correspondence between thalamic and cortical gene-expression profiles across the transcriptome, whereas NMF, OPNMF, and \textit{k}-means more often identified thalamic components with relatively high core-matrix gene expression. This study emphasizes that algorithmic constraints effectively act as biological priors and decomposition methods do not provide neutral compression of the data. We conclude that it is critical to consider whether the algorithmic objective matches the representational geometry of the neurobiology being studied. Overall, our findings suggest that SC studies should select and justify algorithms according to the biological question, explicitly considering whether their constraints favour distributed gradients, overlapping regional parts, or discrete clusters. Meanwhile, interpretations of SC findings could also be informed by the specific algorithmic constraints used to derive them.
papers.translated_summary: 神经影像学研究通常将结构协方差（SC）推导并讨论为潜在脑回路的一种表征，反映协调成熟、解剖连接、转录相似性和共享遗传影响。这些关联促使研究者利用SC来研究发育、衰老和疾病过程中的脑组织。然而，用于推导SC网络的算法施加了可能塑造其生物学解释的约束。为理解算法选择的影响，我们以丘脑皮层系统为例，比较了五种常见的体素级SC表征方法，即主成分分析（PCA）、独立成分分析（ICA）、非负矩阵分解（NMF）、正交投影非负矩阵分解（OPNMF）和k均值聚类，研究对象为来自费城神经发育队列（PNC）的755名8至22岁参与者。基于形变形态测量（DBM）推导的SC网络依据三个互补的生物学基准进行评估：年龄相关的个体差异、基于各向异性分数（FA）的区域特异性丘脑皮层连接的微结构连接，以及艾伦人脑图谱基因表达。每种算法均表现出对神经生物学不同方面的潜在敏感性：PCA和OPNMF在参与者水平成分权重与年龄之间表现出最强的关联。NMF、OPNMF和k均值在阳性皮层SC与纤维束成像推导的投射之间表现出更大的空间重叠。ICA和PCA在整个转录组的丘脑与皮层基因表达谱之间表现出更强的一致性，而NMF、OPNMF和k均值更常识别出具有相对较高核心基质基因表达的丘脑成分。本研究强调，算法约束实际上充当生物学先验，分解方法并不提供数据的中性压缩。我们得出结论，必须考虑算法目标是否与所研究神经生物学的表征几何相匹配。总体而言，我们的发现表明，SC研究应根据生物学问题选择和论证算法，明确考虑其约束是倾向于分布式梯度、重叠区域部分还是离散聚类。同时，对SC发现的解释也可由用于推导它们的特定算法约束来提供信息。

papers.title: Item-specific clustering of high gamma-band activity on theta phase during speech categorization
papers.translated_title: 语音分类过程中高伽马波段活动在theta相位上的项目特异性聚类
papers.author: Ten Oever, S.
papers.summary: Theta-gamma phase-amplitude coupling (PAC) has been proposed as a mechanism for separating neural representations in time. Although item-specific PAC has been reported, its role in perception remains unclear. Notably, previous work has shown that theta phase can bias perception, raising the question whether such biases are linked to phase-specific gamma activity. Here, we investigated whether phase-dependent perceptual biases are accompanied by item-specific theta-gamma PAC. We presented ambiguous speech sounds that could be interpreted as either /da/ or /ga/ in patients with epilepsy implanted with intracranial electrocorticography. We found that pre-stimulus theta phase predicted both the neural and perceptual response, with /da/ and /ga/ tuned channels exhibiting gamma activity clustering at distinct theta phases. These findings suggest that neural and perceptual biases stem from phase-specific pre-activation of item-specific neural representations. They demonstrate the generalizability of the theta-gamma code, shaping behavior and enhancing representational capacity.
papers.translated_summary: Theta-gamma相位-振幅耦合（PAC）已被提出作为一种在时间上分离神经表征的机制。尽管已有研究报告了项目特异性PAC，但其在知觉中的作用仍不清楚。值得注意的是，先前的研究表明theta相位可以偏倚知觉，这引发了一个问题：这种偏倚是否与相位特异性的gamma活动相关联。在此，我们研究了相位依赖的知觉偏倚是否伴随项目特异性的theta-gamma PAC。我们向植入颅内皮层脑电图（electrocorticography）的癫痫患者呈现了可被解读为/da/或/ga/的模糊语音。我们发现，刺激前theta相位预测了神经反应和知觉反应，/da/和/ga/调谐通道的gamma活动聚集在不同的theta相位上。这些发现表明，神经偏倚和知觉偏倚源于项目特异性神经表征的相位特异性预激活。它们证明了theta-gamma编码的普适性，该编码塑造行为并增强表征容量。

papers.title: Disrupting SORL1-retromer endosomal recycling in mice drives the age-dependent neurodegenerative signature of Alzheimer's disease
papers.translated_title: 在小鼠中破坏SORL1-逆转体（retromer）内体回收途径，驱动阿尔茨海默病年龄依赖性神经退行性特征
papers.author: Qureshi, Y. H.
papers.summary: MRI studies have mapped the atrophic signature that distinguishes Alzheimer's disease (AD), isolating regions differentially vulnerable to its age-dependent neurodegenerative process. We test the hypothesis that an endosomal recycling pathway regulated by the interaction of SORL1 with retromer, which is pathogenically disrupted in AD, might drive the neurodegenerative process via multiple yearlong studies in over 140 wildtype and SORL1 deficient mice, modeling AD's causative mutations. MRI studies revealed that SORL1 deficiency induced an age-dependent AD-pattern of atrophy, centered on the trans-entorhinal cortex, and that atrophy was prevented by SORL1 restoration, secondary to overexpressing the retromer protein VPS26b. Postmortem studies validated that the atrophy reflects neuronal loss. Proteomic profiling revealed that the atrophy is associated with reductions in cell death suppressors, one of which was then found deficient in the trans-entorhinal cortex of AD patients. Besides supporting the hypothesis, taken together with other findings, the results suggest that SORL1-retromer disruptions represent a therapeutically-amenable common 'neurodegeneration pathway' in AD.
papers.translated_summary: MRI研究已绘制出区分阿尔茨海默病（AD）的萎缩特征图谱，分离出对该病年龄依赖性神经退行性过程具有差异性易感的脑区。我们通过超过140只野生型和SORL1缺陷小鼠（模拟AD致病突变）的多年期多项研究，检验以下假说：由SORL1与逆转录体相互作用调控的内体回收通路（该通路在AD中病理性受损）可能驱动神经退行性过程。MRI研究显示，SORL1缺陷诱导了以经内嗅皮层为中心的年龄依赖性AD模式萎缩，且该萎缩可通过恢复SORL1（继发于过表达逆转录体蛋白VPS26b）得以预防。死后研究证实该萎缩反映了神经元丢失。蛋白质组学分析显示，该萎缩与细胞死亡抑制因子减少相关，其中一种抑制因子随后被发现于AD患者的经内嗅皮层中表达不足。除支持该假说外，结合其他发现，结果表明SORL1-逆转录体功能破坏代表了AD中一种具有治疗可行性的共同“神经退行性通路”。

papers.title: Generation of human iPSC-derived motor neurons with defined regional identities across the rostrocaudal axis
papers.translated_title: 生成具有沿吻尾轴明确区域身份的人类iPSC来源运动神经元
papers.author: Ning, K.
papers.summary: This study establishes a unified pipeline for generating human induced pluripotent stem cell (iPSC)-derived motor neurons (iMNs) with defined hindbrain, cervical, and lumbar identities to support anatomically resolved studies of motor neuron development and degeneration. Conventional differentiation methods can efficiently produce iMNs but provide limited control over rostrocaudal identity and frequently generate populations with heterogeneous HOX profiles. We addressed this limitation by optimizing developmental morphogen combinations and treatment windows, establishing three complementary protocols that reproducibly generated hindbrain/rhombomere-associated motor neurons (RiMNs), cervical motor neurons (CiMNs), and lumbar motor neurons (LiMNs) across iPSC lines from six non-diseased donors balanced by sex. Transcriptomic and protein analyses demonstrated graded rostrocaudal specification from RiMNs through CiMNs to LiMNs, together with region-appropriate motor neuron subtype features. These identities showed the expected relationships to human week 9 fetal rostrocaudal HOX programs. High-density multielectrode array analysis further revealed synchronized network firing, electrically active neurite networks, and enhanced axonal signal propagation in the regional iMN populations compared with conventionally differentiated iMNs. Spike-sorted recordings additionally revealed protocol-associated differences in single-neuron electrophysiological profiles. Together, this three-protocol pipeline enables the reproducible generation and comparative analysis of anatomically defined human motor neuron populations and provides region-matched cellular models for investigating motor neuron development, selective degeneration, and therapeutic responses.
papers.translated_summary: 本研究建立了一个统一的流程，用于生成具有明确后脑、颈段和腰段身份的人诱导多能干细胞（iPSC）来源的运动神经元（iMNs），以支持对运动神经元发育和退变的解剖学分辨研究。传统分化方法能够高效产生iMNs，但对吻尾身份的控制有限，且经常产生HOX谱异质的细胞群体。我们通过优化发育形态原组合和处理时间窗来解决这一局限，建立了三种互补方案，可在来自六名性别平衡的非患病供体的iPSC系中可重复地生成后脑/菱脑节相关运动神经元（RiMNs）、颈段运动神经元（CiMNs）和腰段运动神经元（LiMNs）。转录组和蛋白质分析显示，从RiMNs经CiMNs到LiMNs存在梯度性吻尾特化，并伴有区域相应的运动神经元亚型特征。这些身份显示出与人类第9周胎儿吻尾HOX程序的预期关系。高密度多电极阵列分析进一步揭示，与常规分化的iMNs相比，区域化iMN群体表现出同步网络放电、电活性神经突网络和增强的轴突信号传播。峰排序记录还揭示了单神经元电生理特征中与方案相关的差异。总之，这一三方案流程能够可重复地生成解剖学定义的人运动神经元群体并进行比较分析，并为研究运动神经元发育、选择性退变和治疗反应提供了区域匹配的细胞模型。
